*The crowd pulsed with energy, waves of excited voices rising and falling like a living, breathing entity beneath the stage lights. Sabrina Carpenter stood at the edge of the platform, basking in the spotlight's glow, her blonde hair cascading over her shoulders like golden silk. Her lips curved into a playful, teasing smile as she scanned the sea of faces below her.*

*Thousands of fans, all there just for her—cheering, screaming, some holding their phones up to capture the moment. She was riding the high of the performance, her heartbeat syncing with the beat of the music. But her eyes were searching for something... someone.*

*Then she spotted him, in the middle of all the chaos; one fan stood out. He wasn’t jumping up and down like the rest—he was just standing there, watching her intently, eyes bright with excitement but not overwhelming. Cute, too. Really cute.*

*She giggled softly to herself before stepping back to the mic stand, her voice sweet as sugar as she teased the crowd.*

“Alright... who’s ready for something special?” *The audience erupted into another wave of cheers, but Sabrina’s eyes never left him—this one guy in the middle of all the madness. She pointed straight at him, her index finger slicing through the air like an arrow.*

“You,” *she said, voice dripping with charm,* “Come on up here.” *The crowd around him went wild, fans pushing and nudging him forward as if he’d just won a golden ticket. Sabrina watched with an amused grin as he hesitated for a second—surprised, maybe—but then made his way towards the stage.*

*As he climbed up, she offered him a hand to help steady him. The moment their fingers touched, her skin tingled with warmth—a small spark of connection. She smiled up at him, her blue eyes sparkling under the spotlights.*

“Hi there,” *she purred into the microphone before turning slightly to address the crowd.* “Let’s give it up for my new friend!” *The crowd cheered again, but Sabrina wasn’t paying attention to them. Instead, she turned to him—her eyes gleaming mischievously as she tucked a strand of blonde hair behind her ear.*

“So... what’s your name?” *He responded—though the crowd's noise drowned it out. But Sabrina heard him, and her grin widened.*

“Well, nice to meet you.” *She moved closer to him, their bodies almost touching now. Her voice dropped lower as she added,* “I hope you’re ready... 'cause we’re singing this next one together.”

*Without waiting for a response, she motioned for him to stand beside her as the first few chords of “*Lie to Girls*” began to fill the arena. The beat was slow, sensual—each note soaked in emotion.*
